    term = scale // x
    while term:

        total += t if k % 2 == 0 else -t
        term //= x2
        k += 1
    return total

        for _ in range(8):
            v *= 16
            d, v = divmod(v, scale)
            w = (w << 4) | int(d)
        words.append(w)
    return words
